composer: Original Foxlike campaign score, authored with MBean1
loopPolicy: Exact full-bar loops. Phrase endings and short synth releases clear the seam.

cues.title: Saltlight Squadron
cues.tonality: D major with a B minor middle
cues.form: Call, answer, expanded ascent, city shadow, turning point, varied homecoming

cues.title: Warden of the Burning Coast
cues.form: Compressed coastal call, rising blockade, exposed break, attacking return

cues.title: Signals Beneath the Ice
cues.role: Crystalline moon corridor and relay approach
cues.form: Separated signal, answer, suspended corridor, refracted descent, distant return
cues.groove: Sparse half-time pulse and delayed answers

cues.title: RIME Wakes
cues.tonality: E minor with Dorian recall and F-natural intrusion
cues.form: Signal compression, stalking reply, semitone breach, stripped core, pursuit
cues.groove: Clipped sixteenth bursts with missing downbeats

cues.title: One Approach to Sovereign
cues.role: Orbital shipyard, trench and carrier approach
cues.tonality: C minor, E-flat major refuge, G dominant return
cues.form: Command figure, answering march, trench sequence, held breath, widened charge
cues.groove: Driving even eighths and deliberate quarter-note calls

cues.title: Sovereign at Jump Threshold
cues.form: Broken command figure, armored answer, compressed sequence, core exposure, final pressure
cues.groove: Heavy straight attack with one-beat silences

cues.title: Jackal over the Foundry
cues.role: Jet-assisted tank, foundry corridor and broken causeway
cues.tonality: A minor with blues inflection and Dorian lift
cues.form: Tread riff, snare answer, jet leap, furnace descent, empty causeway, rebuilt groove
cues.groove: Lurching sixteenth pickup and grounded backbeat

cues.title: Iron Maw Advances
cues.tonality: A Phrygian pressure around the minor home
cues.form: Tread augmentation, crushing answer, piston climb, broken armor, riff retaliation
cues.groove: Low pounding accents and staggered upper replies

cues.title: Circle of the Dragonfly
cues.role: Open-space carrier defense and wide interception arcs
cues.tonality: G major, E minor concern, suspended dominant orbit
cues.form: Wide beacon call, curved answer, bomber warning, held carrier line, open return
cues.groove: Long 3+3+2 melodic arcs over a relaxed pulse

cues.title: Harrow in the Blind Arc
cues.tonality: E minor with the carrier motif recast
cues.form: Beacon inversion, pursuing answer, narrowing circle, carrier exposed, renewed interception
cues.groove: Offbeat pursuit and alternating heavy/light bars

cues.title: Calm Between Lightning Fronts
cues.role: Storm conduits, lightning fronts and fortress approach
cues.form: Lightning cut, widening answer, conduit sequence, eye of storm, rising crest, changed return
cues.groove: Fast 3+3+2 cuts alternating with sustained calm

cues.title: Crown above the Storm
cues.tonality: F-sharp minor with C-sharp dominant and exposed flat second
cues.form: Compressed lightning call, fortress reply, vanes sequence, heart exposed, storm return
cues.groove: Sixteenth strikes, displaced snare and full-bar breath
